verdict.rationale: Zulip documents a public API and a bot framework for building integrations (zulip-docs-4/12/24/27, zulip-docs-5/28), which implies some form of official tooling for developers, but the evidence never names or links actual language SDKs (Python/JS/etc.) and probes show no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt discoverability (zulip-probe-1/2/3). missing for 10: explicit official SDK packages/libraries, language coverage, versioning/maintenance evidence, and machine-readable API spec.
